comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text:
Code review summary for MVP correctness review:

Assessment: Not ready for correctness.

Critical:
- packages/core/src/state/mutateState.ts:160,169,172,202: raw model-supplied values can corrupt typed canonical state fields; SQLite accepts text in numeric columns.
- packages/core/src/sessionClose.ts:48,65,84: closeSessionGracefully can write rollups before proving the session exists.
- packages/core/src/sessionClose.ts:49,55,65,73,84: graceful close is not atomic and can leave session/scene/recap in partial state.

Important:
- Checkpoint failure after close is not retryable through the same API.
- worldQuery overlay prefix LIKE is not escaped for _/% ids.
- Scene APIs allow scenes/logs for nonexistent or closed sessions.
- Module pack validation misses several encounter/NPC cross references.

Minor:
- Checkpoint restore is not transactional/destination-safe.

Follow-up beads created:
- loreweaver-hu0, loreweaver-fgk, loreweaver-c1v, loreweaver-67y, loreweaver-6cp, loreweaver-aq1, loreweaver-kf8.

Scope/verification: reviewer inspected persistence/schema, state mutation, sessions, scenes, orchestrator/tools, context, checkpointing, world validation/query, config, CLI lifecycle, and tests. Reviewer ran targeted repros and npm run test: 35 test files passed, 195 tests passed, 1 skipped. Worktree remained clean.
